findings.text: blocking: the public path builds an augmented map that closes over pairs and passes only system.initial to newton_krylov at :2262, so target and field image can be compiled constants; the one-executable test at tests/equilibrium/test_solve_vertical_pin.py:205 passes pair as a runtime argument to its own wrapper and cannot prove the public compile requirement.

blocking: terminal elongation divides vertical separation by the fixture constant RADIAL_HALF_WIDTH although both solved cells have the same radial first-moment centroid from the residual at :42-43, so the asserted 1.6 does not measure a physical radial extent of the carrier.

follow-on: the free-height check compares the solved centroid with FREE_HEIGHT, the same constant injected into the fixture residual at :45, so changing that constant moves both sides together; the independent target-distance check at :178 only limits where it can move.
follow-on: the declared-coil test checks only the unknown type and direction array and never solves or lowers that branch, so a coil flux_delta regression would leave the focused gate green.

follow-on: radial_field_jet repeats the uniform radial flux formula in scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/measure.py:867 and constraint.py:476; the separate copies can diverge in sign or gauge while their respective tests continue passing.
